Hill Yeah, a sports bar and retail destination, is preparing to open in the former home of Ancora Vino Morgan Hill. The company submitted a liquor license application and signed its lease in late September. An exact opening date has not been announced.

Salad and Go is preparing to return to Arizona, starting with its former Gilbert restaurant, after the chain filed for bankruptcy in August. Partners hope to take possession during the first week of November 2026. They target opening within about 45 days of taking possession.

Curry Leaf Cuisine is set to open in the former Toula's Creole Kitchen. Plans submitted to the city show traditional sit-down service with tandoori specialties, curries, breads, and vegetarian options. The owners have filed for a full liquor license.

data.short_description: Café 66 is preparing to open in downtown Dundas alongside House 66 Beauty + Wellness. It plans to serve coffee, ceremonial matcha, and food made without seed oils or sugar. A firm opening date has not been announced.

data.short_description: Jollibee is planning to open a restaurant inside Lime Ridge Mall, its first permanent Hamilton location. The restaurant will include seating. It previously tested the market in 2021 with a temporary mobile kitchen outside the mall.
Freddy's Frozen Custard & Steakburgers is under construction near Costco in Murfreesboro, close to Interstate 24. The project remains in its early stages. An opening date has not been announced.

Southport Grocery and Cafe is closing after nearly 23 years at its Southport Corridor storefront. Owner Lisa Santos decided to close the business, which opened in 2003. It will close at the end of the year.

data.status: will debut after the grocery store and cafe closes at the end of the year
data.short_description: Dollop Finer Diner, which already operates in Andersonville, will replace Southport Grocery and Cafe. Owner Lisa Santos is behind both businesses. The menu is expected to include sandwiches, pancakes, waffles, soups and salads.
Pizza Nostra is preparing to open its first Toronto location in Etobicoke. The pizzeria currently operates two locations in Mississauga. An opening date has not been confirmed.

Activist Kyle DeVries is planning Lavender Cafe and Bookstore, combining an LGBTQ+-forward book inventory with an all-day cafe that becomes a tapas and mocktail bar in the evenings. DeVries is scouting Downtown locations and currently runs pop-up events. DeVries anticipates securing a permanent home by this winter or after Mardi Gras season.

Starwood Café is planning a new restaurant in the Elevon West shopping center, according to a TDLR filing. Construction on the first-generation restaurant space is scheduled to start Nov. 16 and finish March 29, 2027. The company operates 12 locations across Dallas–Fort Worth.

Pinstripes, acquired by Punch Bowl Social in 2025, will reopen at Orlando's Vineland Pointe under new ownership. The fully renovated space will have 16 bowling lanes, refreshed games, and an upgraded patio. Pinstripes plans to reopen on Nov. 11.

Giorgio's Pizzeria is planning to open on Fourth Street in San Rafael. Its website said construction was underway and that it expected to open in late 2025 or early 2026. An updated opening date has not been announced.

Brasiliana Pizza started construction on a brick-and-mortar restaurant at The Beacon in Grant Park. Owner Thiago Machado hopes to open in February 2027. The restaurant will expand the brand beyond its food court locations.

data.short_description: Willie's Grill & Icehouse is planning a $250,000 expansion at its San Pedro location, according to a TDLR filing. The work will add a dedicated bar and bar dining area. The filing does not say whether a temporary closure will be required.

Picky Barista plans a new Upper West Side location. It will join five other Manhattan locations. The new shop will feature a bright interior with plants, books and handmade wooden tables.

Athens-based Jittery Joe's this month opened its first drive-thru and first franchise location at 299 Grayson Highway in Lawrenceville. Franchise owners Jeff Bates and Adam Gillis are eyeing future markets such as Monroe and Jefferson. The brand hopes to roll out 10 new locations over the next 12 months, focusing on Georgia.

Signage for pizza brand Mister O1 was spotted at a 2,043-square-foot space at The Juniper at 1081 Juniper Street. It is expected to open next year. The brand has three existing locations in Sandy Springs, Inman Park and Buckhead.

Cini Coffee, known for Ethiopian roasts and farmers market appearances, is under construction at 1175 Cambridge Street near Inman Square. It is preparing to open its first permanent café in January 2027. The café is part of the Cambridge Redevelopment Authority's Neighbor Storefronts Project.
